She wears a moon-white, cream-white, or pale blue-white silk-satin ancient-style dress with real folds, delicate flower-branch embroidery, and flowing cuffs. In the upper-left quadrant, a large handwritten brush-script headline reads "Still Here" in thick black strokes, the letters loose and expressive with uneven weight, the word "Still" stacked above "Here" and a short horizontal dash beneath. Directly below that headline, two lines of small black serif type read "Same me." and "A quieter day." in a lighter, more restrained weight than the brush-script above. The central subject occupies the middle and lower half of the frame: a young woman depicted from the shoulders up, her face turned slightly toward the viewer with a calm, neutral expression. Her hair is rendered in dense, heavy charcoal strokes, long and dark, falling past her shoulders on both sides and parted near the centre of her head, with the texture of individual strokes visible throughout. Her face is left mostly unshaded, the paper white showing through for skin, while her eyes are drawn as small dark ovals with defined brows above them, and her lips are a small dark mark. On the upper-left of her head, a small butterfly-shaped hair clip is suggested with a few delicate lines, echoing the accessory in the source photograph. She wears a scoop-neck top rendered in rough cross-hatched charcoal, the leopard-print pattern suggested through irregular dark spots and patches rather than detailed rendering, the neckline curving low across her chest. A thin gold necklace with a small round pendant hangs at her collarbone, drawn as a fine single line with a tiny circle at its centre. On the right side of the frame, roughly at mid-height, a small black serif label reads "NO. 01" with a thin horizontal rule drawn directly beneath it. Below that, in the lower-right area, three short lines of small black serif type read "Some faces" "carry" "silent stories." stacked vertically with generous leading. The lighting is flat and even across the entire composition, with no cast shadows or highlights, consistent with a hand-drawn illustration on a paper surface where all depth comes from line weight and stroke density rather than light direction. The overall composition is balanced and minimalist, with the dense dark charcoal mass of the figure anchoring the centre while the sparse text elements float in the negative space on either side, creating a quiet, contemplative mood on a restrained palette of black ink on cream paper.
